useCase: 检测图像篡改 via re-saving, quality 不一致, and spliced JPEG regions
mechanism: Re-compresses the image at multiple quality factors and 测量 the difference map for each. Regions that were previously compressed at a specific quality show minimal difference (ghost) at that quality level, revealing 篡改.
name: JPEG幽灵分析
parameters: Quality range: 50-99, Step: 1, 块大小: 8x8, Detection 阈值: 自适应 per-image
description: 检测 traces of previous JPEG压缩s (ghosts) that reveal re-saving or 篡改. AI生成的 images may have inconsistent compression histories.

references.title: Farid, H. (2009). Exposing Digital Forgeries from JPEG Ghosts. IEEE TIFS.
Li, W. et al. (2009). Passive Detection of Doctored JPEG Image via Block Artifact Grid Extraction. Signal Processing.

strengths:
• Localizes tampered regions specifically
• Strong evidence of re-compression
• Can estimate original quality factor
• Well-proven 取证 methodology
limitations:
• 仅适用于JPEG图像
• 计算密集 (multiple re-compressions)
• Same-quality re-compression is undetectable
• AI生成的 JPEGs without 篡改 won't show ghosts
